headline: Clinton order makes further changes to an earlier order on protecting the nation's critical infrastructure.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13010 again, after it had already been amended once. Order 13010 set up a presidential commission to study how to protect vital systems such as power, phone networks, and transportation from physical and computer attacks. The title does not say exactly what this order changes, so the specific details are unclear.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials working on critical infrastructure protection
who_it_affects.how: They may face changes to how the commission set up under Order 13010 is organized or run.
